filename: Curated API Authorization and BOLA Lab
title: API Authorization & BOLA (IDOR)
title_si: API Authorization සහ BOLA (IDOR) ප්‍රායෝගික පාඩම
accuracy_note: Aligned with OWASP API Security Top 10 2023 API1: Broken Object Level Authorization. Test only accounts and endpoints you are authorized to assess.
summary_si: Object ID එක වෙනස් කිරීමෙන් වෙනත් user කෙනෙකුගේ resource එකකට access ලැබෙනවාද කියා authorization boundary එක පරීක්ෂා කරන පාඩම.
summary_en: A practical, safe workflow for testing object-level authorization without confusing authentication with authorization.

tasks.sinhala_content: Login වීමෙන් user කෙනා කවුද කියන එක තහවුරු වෙනවා. නමුත් request එකේ object එකට එම user ට permission තියෙනවාද කියන එක server-side check එකක්. Client එකෙන් එන user_id හෝ object_id එක trust කරන්න එපා.
tasks.english_summary: Authentication identifies the caller; authorization decides whether that caller may access this specific object. Enforce the decision on the server for every request.

qa.question: Where must object authorization be enforced?
qa.answer: On the server, for every object access, using the authenticated principal and the requested object's ownership or policy.

tasks.sinhala_content: ඔයාගේම lab accounts දෙකක් භාවිතා කරලා Account A ගේ object ID එක Account B token එකෙන් request කරන්න. Status code එක විතරක් නොව response body, timing, side effects සහ audit log එකත් compare කරන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Use two authorized test accounts. Replay an otherwise identical request with the second account's token and verify that the server returns a consistent denial without leaking metadata.

qa.question: What is a reliable negative test?
qa.answer: A valid authenticated user attempting to access another test user's object must receive a policy-consistent denial and no sensitive data.

tasks.sinhala_content: Resource lookup එක user context එකට bind කරන්න. UUID භාවිතා කිරීම පමණක් fix එකක් නොවේ. Ownership, tenant boundary, role policy සහ audit logging එකට test cases ලියන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Use policy-aware queries such as retrieving an object by both object_id and authenticated owner/tenant. Add authorization tests for read, update, delete, bulk and nested resources.
code_examples: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id = ? AND owner_id = ?;

qa.question: Why is changing numeric IDs to UUIDs not a complete fix?
qa.answer: UUIDs reduce guessing but do not enforce authorization; a leaked or supplied UUID is still usable if the server does not check ownership.

blue_team_defense.remediation: Centralize authorization policies, derive identity from the validated session/token, scope database queries by tenant and owner, and deny by default.
blue_team_defense.detection: Log principal, object, action, policy decision and correlation ID. Alert on repeated cross-tenant denials or unusual sequential object access.
checklist: Avoid sensitive data in error responses

filename: Curated Cloud IAM and Metadata Security Lab
title: Cloud IAM, Metadata & Least Privilege
title_si: Cloud IAM, Metadata සහ Least Privilege ආරක්ෂාව
mitre_attack: T1078.004 (Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts), T1552.005 (Cloud Instance Metadata API)
accuracy_note: Provider-neutral concepts with AWS examples. Use a disposable cloud account and never query metadata on systems you do not own.
summary_si: Cloud identity permissions, short-lived credentials සහ instance metadata exposure අවදානම් නිවැරදිව model කරන පාඩම.
summary_en: Understand cloud identity boundaries, temporary credentials, metadata protections and practical least-privilege review.

tasks.sinhala_content: User එකට attach කරපු policy එක පමණක් නොව group, role assumption, resource policy සහ session policy එකතුවෙන් effective permission එක හැදෙනවා.
tasks.english_summary: Review identity policies, groups, trust policies, resource policies and permission boundaries together. A narrowly named policy can still produce broad effective access through role chaining.

qa.question: What does least privilege mean in IAM?
qa.answer: Grant only the actions, resources and conditions required for the workload, for the shortest practical duration.

tasks.sinhala_content: Metadata endpoint එකෙන් temporary role credentials leak වුණොත් instance compromise එක cloud compromise එකක් වෙන්න පුළුවන්. SSRF defenses සමඟ provider metadata hardening එකත් අවශ්‍යයි.
tasks.english_summary: Treat instance metadata as a privileged local boundary. Use IMDSv2 where available, restrict egress, block SSRF primitives and avoid long-lived keys on instances.

qa.question: Does IMDSv2 alone fix SSRF?
qa.answer: No. It raises the bar, but applications still need SSRF defenses, egress controls and minimal instance-role permissions.

tasks.sinhala_content: CloudTrail, GuardDuty සහ identity provider logs එකතු කරලා unusual AssumeRole, access-key creation, region changes සහ policy changes monitor කරන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Monitor policy mutations, new access keys, unusual AssumeRole chains, disabled logging and access from unexpected geographies or workloads.

qa.question: Which events deserve high priority?
qa.answer: Logging changes, privilege policy changes, new credentials and role assumptions from unexpected principals or locations.

blue_team_defense.remediation: Use federation and short-lived credentials, permission boundaries, explicit resource scopes, deny-by-default conditions and separate production roles.
blue_team_defense.detection: Centralize CloudTrail or equivalent audit logs. Alert on IAM policy changes, key creation, unusual role assumptions and metadata-related application errors.

filename: Curated Windows DFIR Initial Triage Lab
title: DFIR: Windows Initial Triage
title_si: DFIR: Windows Initial Triage සහ Evidence Handling
accuracy_note: For isolated lab images or approved incident response. Preserve originals and document chain of custody.
summary_si: Incident එකක් confirm කිරීමට පෙර volatile evidence, event logs, persistence points සහ user activity systematic ලෙස triage කරන workflow එක.
summary_en: A repeatable first-response workflow that preserves evidence, establishes scope and avoids contaminating the host.

tasks.sinhala_content: මුලින් system owner, time zone, host ID සහ evidence hash record කරන්න. Original files මත analysis නොකර working copy භාවිතා කරන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Record scope, timestamps, system identity and acquisition details. Hash collected artifacts and maintain a documented chain of custody.

qa.question: Why hash evidence?
qa.answer: To demonstrate that the collected artifact was not altered between acquisition and analysis.

tasks.sinhala_content: 4624/4625 logons, 4688 process creation, 7045 service installation, PowerShell logs සහ scheduled tasks timeline එකක් විදිහට correlate කරන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Correlate authentication, process creation, service installation, PowerShell and scheduled-task telemetry rather than treating one event as proof.

qa.question: Why correlate multiple event sources?
qa.answer: Individual events are ambiguous; time-correlated evidence provides stronger context and reduces false positives.

tasks.sinhala_content: Affected account, hosts, first-seen time, persistence mechanism සහ impacted data record කරලා containment action එක approval එක්ක කරන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Document affected identities, hosts, first-seen time, persistence and business impact. Separate containment from eradication and recovery decisions.

qa.question: What should an initial triage report answer?
qa.answer: What happened, when it started, which identities/hosts are involved, what evidence supports it and what remains unknown.

blue_team_defense.remediation: Enable centralized logging, PowerShell Script Block Logging, process creation telemetry and time synchronization. Restrict log access and retain logs immutably.
blue_team_defense.detection: Correlate 4624/4625, 4688, 7045, PowerShell 4104 and Sysmon process/network events with a common timeline.

title: Kerberoasting: Attack Mechanics & Defense
mitre_attack: T1558.003 (Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting)
accuracy_note: Use only in an authorized AD lab. Kerberoasting requests a service ticket; it does not directly dump a plaintext password.
summary_si: SPN තියෙන service account එකකට TGS request කරලා ticket encryption material offline crack කිරීමට ඇති risk එක සහ defense.
summary_en: Learn what a service ticket exposes, why weak service-account passwords matter and how to reduce the attack surface.

tasks.sinhala_content: SPN එක service instance එකක් AD තුළ identify කරන නමක්. Authenticated domain user කෙනෙකුට service ticket request කරන්න පුළුවන්. Ticket material offline analysis කළත් password එක weak නම් risk එකක්.
tasks.english_summary: An SPN maps a service instance to an account. A domain principal can request a TGS for it; the encrypted ticket can be assessed offline, making password strength critical.

qa.question: What is the key prerequisite?
qa.answer: A service account with an SPN and a password that is weak enough to be recovered through offline guessing.

tasks.sinhala_content: Lab එකේ scope එක confirm කරලා SPN accounts, encryption types, password age සහ privilege relationships review කරන්න. High privilege service accounts priority කරන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Prioritize accounts with SPNs, high privileges, stale passwords or legacy encryption. Enumeration alone does not prove compromise.

qa.question: Does every SPN account imply a vulnerability?
qa.answer: No. The risk depends on password strength, account privilege, encryption configuration and monitoring.

tasks.sinhala_content: gMSA භාවිතා කරන්න, long random passwords දාන්න, unnecessary SPNs remove කරන්න, privileged users service accounts විදිහට භාවිතා නොකරන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Prefer gMSAs, long random secrets, AES encryption and least privilege. Monitor unusual TGS request volume and service-account usage.

qa.question: What is a strong mitigation?
qa.answer: Use gMSAs or long random rotated passwords for service accounts and remove unnecessary privilege.

blue_team_defense.remediation: Use gMSAs, remove unused SPNs, enforce long random service-account secrets, AES Kerberos and least privilege.
blue_team_defense.detection: Baseline TGS requests and alert on bursts, unusual client hosts, legacy encryption and service-account logons from workstations.
checklist: Remove Domain Admin from service accounts

title: Bug Bounty Recon & Responsible Testing
title_si: Bug Bounty Recon සහ වගකීම් සහිත පරීක්ෂණ ක්‍රමය
mitre_attack: T1595 (Active Scanning), T1592 (Gather Victim Host Information)
accuracy_note: Only test targets explicitly listed in a current program scope. Respect rate limits, privacy rules, safe-harbor language and stop conditions.
summary_si: Scope-first asset discovery, low-impact validation සහ reproducible report එකක් හදන bug bounty workflow එක.
summary_en: A scope-first methodology for discovering assets, validating impact safely and writing reproducible reports.

tasks.sinhala_content: Program scope, excluded assets, rate limits, prohibited actions සහ disclosure rules කියවලා local notes එකක් හදන්න. Scope එක unclear නම් test නොකර program owner ගෙන් අහන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Read the current policy before touching an asset. Record in-scope domains, exclusions, rate limits, prohibited actions, data-handling rules and reporting channels.
code_examples: printf '%s\n' 'IN-SCOPE: example.test' 'RATE: 1 req/sec' 'NO: destructive testing' > scope.txt

qa.question: What is the first recon tool?
qa.answer: The program policy and scope document; technical scanning comes after authorization is clear.

tasks.sinhala_content: Passive sources සහ permitted DNS queries වලින් assets collect කරලා live hosts manually verify කරන්න. Production systems මත aggressive scanning avoid කරන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Start with passive discovery and permitted DNS checks. Deduplicate assets, label confidence and avoid high-volume scans unless the policy explicitly allows them.

qa.question: Why label asset confidence?
qa.answer: It separates confirmed in-scope assets from passive leads and prevents accidental testing of unrelated infrastructure.

tasks.sinhala_content: Impact prove කිරීමට minimum evidence එකක් පමණක් collect කරන්න. Real user data access නොකර redact කළ screenshots, request/response, steps සහ remediation දෙන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Use the smallest non-destructive proof. Include reproducible steps, expected versus actual behavior, impact, affected asset, timestamps, redacted evidence and remediation.

qa.question: What makes a report actionable?
qa.answer: Clear reproduction steps, scope, impact, safe evidence, severity rationale and a concrete remediation suggestion.

tasks.sinhala_content: Scope file එකේ තියෙන domains පමණක් passive discovery, HTTP probing සහ low-rate content discovery සඳහා pipeline කරන්න. Tool එකකට rate limit දාන්න, output එක deduplicate කරලා manually verify කරන්න.
tasks.english_summary: A safe pipeline is: scope validation, passive enumeration, HTTP probing, low-rate discovery, manual verification and reporting. Automation produces leads, not proof.

qa.question: Why use low rate limits and manual verification?
qa.answer: To reduce service impact, respect program rules and eliminate scanner false positives before reporting.

blue_team_defense.remediation: Maintain an asset inventory, remove forgotten services, enforce authentication and publish a clear vulnerability disclosure policy.
blue_team_defense.detection: Monitor unusual enumeration, rate-limit abuse and repeated probing while preserving researcher-friendly response and safe-harbor processes.

title: Rust for Ethical Hacking & Defense
title_si: Ethical Hacking සහ Defense සඳහා Rust භාවිතය
mitre_attack: T1587.001 (Develop Capabilities: Malware), T1059 (Command and Scripting Interpreter)
cwe: CWE-787 (Out-of-Bounds Write), CWE-134 (Use of Externally-Controlled Format String)
accuracy_note: Use these examples against localhost, a disposable lab, or explicitly authorized targets. Rust memory safety does not make network tools automatically safe.
summary_si: Rust භාවිතයෙන් fast, portable සහ memory-safe security utilities—authorized reconnaissance, log analysis, hashing සහ defensive automation—හදන ක්‍රමය.
summary_en: Build fast, portable and memory-safe security utilities in Rust for authorized reconnaissance, defensive automation, log analysis and evidence handling.

tasks.task_title: Install and Secure a Rust Workspace
tasks.sinhala_content: rustup install කරලා cargo project එකක් හදන්න. `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy` සහ `cargo audit` CI එකට දාන්න. Rust memory-safe වුණත් dependency, authorization සහ output handling තවමත් developer responsibility එකක්.
tasks.english_summary: Install Rust with rustup, initialize a Cargo project and enforce formatting, linting and dependency auditing. Memory safety does not eliminate logic, authorization or supply-chain risks.

qa.question: Does Rust make an offensive tool safe by default?
qa.answer: No. Rust reduces many memory-safety bugs, but scope, authorization, dependency risk and operational impact still require controls.

tasks.sinhala_content: Public web response එකේ security headers check කරන defensive utility එකක් හදන්න. Target එක command-line argument එකෙන් ගන්න, HTTPS certificate validation disable නොකරන්න, timeout එකක් දාන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Use Rust and reqwest to inspect headers on an authorized URL. Keep TLS verification enabled, set a timeout and report missing defensive headers without exploiting the target.
code_examples: cargo add reqwest --features rustls-tls && cargo add tokio --features macros,rt-multi-thread

use reqwest::Client; #[tokio::main] async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> { let url = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("usage: header-audit <URL>"); let response = Client::builder().timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10)).build()?.get(url).send().await?; for name in ["content-security-policy", "strict-transport-security", "x-content-type-options"] { println!("{}: {}", name, response.headers().get(name).map(|v| v.to_str().unwrap_or("<invalid>")).unwrap_or("MISSING")); } Ok(()) }

qa.question: Why should TLS verification remain enabled?
qa.answer: Disabling verification hides certificate problems and makes the tool unsafe to use as a trustworthy defensive auditor.

tasks.sinhala_content: Large web logs line-by-line stream කරලා repeated 401/403 spikes, suspicious path patterns සහ source IP counts identify කරන්න. File එක memory එකට සම්පූර්ණයෙන් load නොකර bounded parsing භාවිතා කරන්න.
tasks.english_summary: Rust is useful for fast, low-memory log processing. Parse line by line, normalize input, avoid logging secrets and emit aggregate indicators for analyst review.
code_examples: cargo add clap --features derive && cargo add regex

qa.question: What is the defensive value of streaming logs?
qa.answer: It handles large files with bounded memory and supports near-real-time detection without retaining unnecessary sensitive content.

tasks.task_title: Safe Port Inventory in a Lab
tasks.sinhala_content: ඔයාගේම localhost හෝ lab host එකක service inventory එකක් build කරන්න. Port range, concurrency සහ timeout explicit කරන්න. Internet-wide scanning හෝ stealth features මේ educational utility එකට දාන්න එපා.
tasks.english_summary: For a lab-only TCP inventory, constrain the target, port range, concurrency and timeout. Treat connection results as an inventory signal, not proof of a vulnerability.
code_examples: cargo add clap --features derive && cargo add tokio --features full

qa.question: What limits make a lab scanner safer?
qa.answer: An explicit authorized host, bounded port range, low concurrency, short timeout and no evasion or exploitation behavior.

blue_team_defense.remediation: Use Rust for memory-safe parsers, signed builds, least-privilege agents and deterministic defensive utilities. Pin and audit dependencies.
blue_team_defense.detection: Monitor unexpected outbound connection bursts, unsigned binaries, unusual command-line arguments and new security-tool execution on production hosts.
